com.empline/tool-documentation.access: Requires OAuth store:listings:drafts:write consent. Requires separate store:listings:drafts:write consent and current EDIT_LISTINGS permission on an approved owned store. Optional photo order additionally requires store:listings:drafts:images:write; existing catalog/copy grants never acquire photo-write authority. Existing read and price grants do not authorize drafts. One draft per plan; nine-minute expiry; execute accepts only the plan and stable idempotency key.
com.empline/tool-documentation.effects: Preparation persists an expiring plan. Execution saves an exact catalog link, optional draft seller notes and either a frozen photo permutation or one explicit photo rotation through the native save-drafts owner. Photo changes require additional photo-write consent. Rotation retains its stable base and originals and creates a complete verified artifact set with a durable receipt; ambiguous uploads are never repeated. The listing remains DRAFT; there are no marketplace writes.
com.empline/tool-documentation.failures: Missing or foreign drafts, unowned preserved originals, incomplete photo pairs, stale versions, changed catalogs and revoked authority fail. After a lost response, inspect the same operation or find it by its original key; unknown outcomes must not be retried as new intent.
com.empline/tool-documentation.notFor: No arbitrary photo URLs, chat-attachment ingestion, new catalog rows, grading or authenticity verification, price, inventory or publication changes.
com.empline/tool-documentation.purpose: Freeze one exact owned photo draft, an explicit existing catalog card, optional draft seller notes and either a full saved-photo permutation or one explicit quarter/half-turn rotation. Photo edits require additional image-write consent and preserve original archives. Rotation renders once from the stable base into new verified display artifacts; restoring the base, cropping, adding and deleting photos are unavailable. Use the native upload link for new photos before preparing.
com.empline/tool-documentation.returns: A strict canonical plan or durable operation envelope with exact listing, catalog and version references. Private photo and card-data snapshots stay server-side.
com.empline/tool-documentation.useWhen: Save front and back photos through SuperCatch's authenticated /store/listings/new flow, inspect that owned DRAFT and select an exact existing catalog card. Prepare and execute a single frozen update to that same draft.

catalog_id.description: Exact existing catalog row ID selected in the native listing flow. This cannot create a catalog row.

catalog_type.description: Exact native catalog family of the selected existing card; mismatched families are refused.

copy_edits.description: Optional explicit copy edits for this saved draft only; no price, inventory, condition, grade or identity replacement fields are accepted.

seller_notes.description: Optional seller notes copied into the draft's raw card data; this is not a live listing description.

expected_version.description: Exact updated_at version returned by the native draft surface; stale drafts cannot be updated.

image_order.description: Requires separate store:listings:drafts:images:write consent alongside draft-write consent. Optional exact permutation of saved photo positions: each output position names its previous zero-based index. Must include every saved photo exactly once. Moves existing photos and original pointers; cannot crop, rotate, add or delete photos.

photo_rotation.description: Requires separate photo-write consent. Rotate one saved photo by an explicit clockwise quarter or half turn (negative means counterclockwise). Cannot be combined with image_order; no caller URLs, crop, replacement or deletion.

degrees.description: Explicit clockwise turn in degrees: -90 turns counterclockwise, 90 clockwise, and 180 a half turn. The turn composes with the saved edit state from its stable display base.

image_index.description: Exact zero-based saved photo position from the current owned draft; this does not add or replace a photo.

source_draft_id.description: Exact existing DRAFT listing ID owned by this store.
